food-alouda.prompt: Create one original polished watercolor travel-food illustration for a destination guide card, landscape 3:2. A single coherent close-up scene with the prepared dish filling most of the frame; clearly hand-painted pigment and paper texture, soft natural light, appetizing accurate ingredients, refined restrained colors. No words, lettering, captions, logos, collage, multi-panel, people, or misleading photorealism. Quiet warm ivory background with a subtle place-appropriate colored wash; no busy props. Subject: Mauritian alouda cold milk drink in a single tall clear ribbed glass: pale pink rose-flavored sweet milk with many tiny black basil seeds each in translucent hydrated gel, fine translucent agar jelly shreds visible through the glass, some ice and slight condensation. A small cream-colored scoop of vanilla ice cream on top, slender plain straw and spoon. The basil seeds must be tiny, not large boba pearls. Pastel coral and turquoise island-market mood, drink is hero.
